title: To: All customers · From: Bluewave Internet · Subject: Scheduled maintenance
L: Dear customer, Bluewave Internet will carry out maintenance on our network on Saturday, June 7, between 1:00 A.M. and 5:00 A.M.
During this time, your internet service may be unavailable.
We have chosen these hours because very few customers are online.
The work will make your connection faster and more reliable.
After the work is complete, you may need to restart your modem.
Simply turn it off and on again.
We apologize for any inconvenience and thank you for choosing Bluewave.

exq.why: be + tính từ: may be unavailable (có thể không dùng được).

exq.a: The work will make your connection faster and more reliable.
w: The maintenance was completed successfully last Saturday.
Most of our customers are online at this time of night.
Your service will therefore not be affected at all.
exq.why: Câu chèn nói lợi ích của việc bảo trì, trước câu dặn khởi động lại modem. Bảo trì đã xong ngược với "will carry out"; nhiều khách online ngược với câu trước; "không ảnh hưởng gì" ngược với "may be unavailable".
need to + động từ nguyên mẫu → restart.
Sau giới từ for dùng V-ing: thank you for choosing.
